newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aramco naphtha premium to be bid over $3.40-trader.
newsitem.headline: Aramco naphtha premium to be bid over $3.40-trader.

text.p: Bidding levels for Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura A-180 term naphtha cargoes are expected to be somewhat higher than $3.40 over the Aramco formula for 1997, traders said on Friday.

The initial bids from Japanese buyers are likely to be a little higher than a current premium of $3.40, which was applied for the second half of 1996, but lower than another premium of $4.00, which was set for the August 1996-July 1997 period.
The naphtha term tender closes at midnight Dhahran time on Friday, they said.
The new premium for 1997 is expected to be set by the end of October, traders said.
Saudi Arabia exports 2.2 to 2.5 million tonnes of A-180 on a term basis to Japan and South Korea annually, traders said.
